messages:
Maya (CS): Heads up — we have an incident impacting the tokenization layer that caused truncated/incorrect payloads for a subset of onboarding customers in the last ~6h. Drafting comms for affected accounts, pls ping if you’ll own outreach.

IncidentBot: Incident created: INC-2024-1672 — Tokenization errors. Status: investigating. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2024-1672

Jorge (Account Exec): Flagged high-touch accounts: AcmeCorp, LumenHealth, FathomAI. DMed the AEs and put them on notice.

Maya (CS): Thanks @Jorge. @Leah can you draft a concise email for AcmeCorp (they're renewal-sensitive)? Needs: what happened, what we did, mitigation, ETA for RCA, offer 1:1 call, credit note.

Leah (CS Ops): On it. Proposed subject: `Redwood — brief outage affecting responses (update)`. Drafting body now.

Raj (Solutions): For renewal-risk customers add: “we will credit impacted token usage and offer a technical review call to cover prompt adjustments”. Also include link to workaround doc.

Maya (CS): Agree. Also set account health flag in Gainsight: `incident_outreach=true` and mark renewal risk = `medium` for AcmeCorp.

Leah (CS Ops): Paste draft email below:

Hi <first_name>,

We’re sorry — earlier today Redwood experienced a partial degradation affecting text responses for some customers. This was caused by a tokenizer change that produced truncated outputs for certain inputs.

What we did: rolled back the tokenizer change, flushed KV caches, and redeployed a fix. Full service restored at 15:42 UTC.

Interim mitigation: requests are being reprocessed where possible; you will receive credited token usage for any impacted calls.

Next steps: full RCA by 18:00 UTC and we’re offering a 1:1 technical review call to go over prompt/ingestion changes.

Sincerely,
Leah on behalf of Redwood CS

Thoughts?

Jorge (Account Exec): :thumbsup: Clean. Add link to status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-1672 and a short FAQ bullet about truncated outputs.

IncidentBot: Status update: root cause identified — tokenizer regression from commit `abc123`. Fix deployed at 15:38 UTC. Monitoring: green.

Leah (CS Ops): Emails sent to AcmeCorp and LumenHealth, logged outreach in CRM, calendar invites created (tentative) for review calls.

Maya (CS): Acme replied, asking for immediate RCA + confirmation of credits. They want the call today. @Raj can you take Acme at 17:00 UTC?

Raj (Solutions): I can. Will prepare runbook + prompt-swap guide and demo.

Maya (CS): Also capture customer feedback in the incident notes: request for clearer SLA around truncation and proactive alerts. This may affect renewal conversation.

Leah (CS Ops): Adding detailed notes to incident doc and will post link here after call.

Jorge (Account Exec): Flagging renewal team: Acme renewal Q3 could slip; created task AS-452 in Asana and assigned renewal lead.

IncidentBot: INC-2024-1672 updated: RCA draft available — https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/INC-2024-1672-rca (finalization in progress).

Maya (CS): Summary/next steps: resolution confirmed 15:42 UTC; impacted accounts notified; credits promised; 1:1 calls scheduled. Once RCA reviewed I’ll publish final note to status page and send follow-up to all impacted. Thanks all.
